description: Low-resolution screenshot of a multi-channel security-camera (CCTV) monitor display, showing several night-vision/infrared camera feeds labeled by channel number (Ch11, Ch15 and others partially visible). description: Mobile phone screenshot of the qmap.pub aggregator showing Q drop 3152, titled by the site 'Prince Andrew is Deeply Connected to Rachel Chandler', dated 20 Mar 2019. The drop quotes an anonymous post attaching a party photograph of Prince Andrew grinning while a blonde woman drapes her arm around his neck and leans toward his face; the image filename labels her only as a 'designer'. Q replies 'Prince Andrew is deeply connected.' The woman in the photo is not identified in the image itself.
text: 10:24. qmap.pub. 6. 3152. Prince Andrew is Deeply Connected to Rachel Chandler. Q !!mG7VJxZNCI 20 Mar 2019 - 11:05:27 PM. Anonymous 20 Mar 2019 - 10:55:49 PM. Prince-Andrew-with-designer-420164.jpg. >>5801599. >>5801617. Prince Andrew is deeply connected. Q
flags: The site headline connecting Prince Andrew to Rachel Chandler is the drop/aggregator's claim, not established fact
Woman in the photo unidentified; filename calls her a designer

description: Screenshot of Q drop 4565 (Jul 2 2020) as rendered by an aggregator. The drop speculates that Jeffrey Epstein was a puppet financed by foreign entities to gather blackmail on politicians, royalty, Hollywood and Wall Street figures, and raises the Maxwell family background and Robert Maxwell's intelligence/wealth history. All content is the drop's own claim.
text: Q !!Hs1Jq13jV6 ID: e67d38 No.9827385. 4565. Jul 2 2020 12:53:00 (EST). Possible Epstein was a puppet [not the main person(s) of interest]? Financed by who or what [F] entities? 1. [Primary] gather blackmail on elected pols, dignitaries, royalty, hollywood influencers, wall street and other financial top level players, other high profile industry specific people, etc. 2. Feed an addiction [controllable]. Maxwell family background? Robert Maxwell history [intel, agency, wealth, [CLAS 1-99]]? Sometimes it's the people in the background that are of greater significance. Q
flags: Drop's claims about Epstein being financed for blackmail are unverified speculation posed as questions

description: Front cover of the New York Post (Metro Edition), Sunday July 5 2020, headlined 'SHAME OF THRONES'. The cover photo shows Ghislaine Maxwell and Kevin Spacey seated on the red-and-gold thrones of Buckingham Palace, a 2002 photo the paper says was taken during a private tour arranged through Prince Andrew. A sidebar promotes complete Epstein coverage on pages 4-7.
text: NEW YORK POST. METRO EDITION. SUNDAY, JULY 5, 2020 / Partly cloudy, 84 / Weather: Page 24. SUNDAY. nypost.com. $2.00. When king and queen of perversion Ghislaine Maxwell and Kevin Spacey hung out in Buckingham Palace. SHAME OF THRONES. The Usual Suspect: Ghislaine Maxwell gets comfy alongside actor Kevin Spacey as they test their royal seats on Queen Elizabeth and Prince Philip's thrones of Buckingham Palace... during a private tour of Buckingham Palace organized by her friend Prince Andrew... Manhattan federal indictment for allegedly recruiting underage girls for her ex-lover Jeffrey Epstein, and Spacey, 60, has since been accused of sexual misconduct, though he has never been convicted. COMPLETE EPSTEIN COVERAGE: PAGES 4-7.
flags: Sidebar fine print only partially legible; its transcription is approximate in places
'King and queen of perversion' characterization is the tabloid's, not the archive's

description: Screenshot of Q drop 3537 (Jul 29 2019) as rendered by an aggregator. Q quotes an anonymous 8chan post that replies 'Wray is a sleeper' — referring to FBI Director Christopher Wray — and answers 'Future marker.' The 'sleeper' characterization is the anon's claim, echoed by Q's cryptic reply.
text: Q !!mG7VJxZNCI ID: fce708 No.7243904. 3537. Jul 29 2019 12:14:03 (EST). Anonymous ID: d7cbcd No.7243889. Jul 29 2019 12:13:22 (EST). >>7243859. Wray is a sleeper. >>7243889. Future marker. Q
